_comment_pred_dir: Folder containing raw prediction XDMF files for one model run.
_comment_dataset_dir: Folder containing dataset truth XDMFs used to inject levelset when absent in predictions.
_comment_configs_pool: Pickle file with per-case metadata (case id, geometry, Reynolds).
_comment_model_name: Model identifier used for output folder naming under output_dir/model_name.
_comment_output_dir: Root directory where postprocessing outputs are written.
_comment_feature_map: Mapping from x* channels in prediction XDMF to semantic meaning. x0/x1/x2 are expected to be velocity_x/velocity_y/pressure.
_comment_target_map: Mapping from y* channels to target semantics. Used for shifted target alignment.
_comment_target_step_offset: Number of steps by which targets lead predictions (usually 1).
_comment_rollout_steps: Optional rollout cap. null means full rollout.
_comment_sensor_mode: Sensor placement mode: auto (from configs_pool geometry) or csv (from sensor_csv file).
_comment_sensor_csv: CSV with sensor_id,x,y columns, used only when sensor_mode is csv.
_comment_levelset_source: prediction if levelset exists in prediction feature_map; dataset to inject from dataset_dir.
